body.message:
It will be a self check-in, Khizar. Once your booking is confirmed, our team will prepare the apartment tomorrow, 6 September.

So between 1 to 3pm, once the unit is ready, our Guest Relations Team will share all the check-in details with you, including the apartment number, Wi-Fi details, parking code, and other necessary information.

Once you receive the details, you can simply proceed to the apartment and check in.
